subject: general
question: Which of the following regions of India has the maximum concentration of iron and steel industries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhota Nagpur plateau**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Chhota Nagpur plateau** in **eastern India**, covering parts of **Jharkhand, Bihar, and Odisha**, has the **maximum** concentration of **iron and steel** industries in India.
 
• The region has abundant reserves of **high-grade iron ore, coal, and limestone**, which are the essential raw materials for the production of iron and steel.
 
• The** first iron and steel plant** in India, the **Tata Iron and Steel Company (TISCO)**, was established in **1907** in **Jamshedpur**, which is located in the Chhota Nagpur plateau region.
 
• Other major steel plants in the region include the **Bokaro Steel Plant, Rourkela Steel Plant, and Durgapur Steel Plant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Western Ghats **are a **mountain range** in western India known for their biodiversity and scenic beauty.

 
 
• It is passing across the states of** Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Goa, and Gujarat.**
 
• **Bauxite, manganese, and iron** ores abound in the Western Ghats.
 
 
 
• The **Deccan Plateau** is a large plateau in southern India known for its** agriculture, mineral resources, and historical monuments**.
 
 
• Its northern boundary is formed by the **Vindhya and Satpura Ranges.**
 
• Numerous industries, like as **steel, chemicals, mining, and textile **production, are based in the Deccan Plateau.
 
 
 
• The** Indo-Gangetic plains** are a **fertile plain **in northern India known for their agriculture and population density.
 
 
• In the Indo Gangetic,** farming, fishing, and animal husbandry** are the primary industries.
